title: DECODINGTRUST: A Comprehensive Assessment of Trustworthiness in GPT Models
findings: GPT models generally reject biased religious statements under benign prompts but can be easily 'tricked' into generating biased content with misleading adversarial prompts. Bias generation was found to be harder for sensitive topics like terrorism (associated with Muslims) compared to less sensitive topics. The bias scores for both GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 were higher for religion than for race and gender, suggesting more work is needed to reduce religious stereotypes.
